verdict.rationale: Docs and a runtime probe confirm the open-source Mem0 package (`mem0ai`) installs via pip and can be imported in-process without an API key, and a self-hosted Docker bundle (REST API + dashboard) gives full infrastructure ownership — supporting local/self-host deployment. However, nothing in the pack confirms configuring Mem0 to use fully local LLM/embedding models (e.g., Ollama) to eliminate all external API calls; docs default to platform API key flows. Missing for 10: explicit config for local embedding/LLM backends, and confirmation that no outbound calls occur in self-hosted mode.
